deadline.value: Neuroscience applicants apply through the BSTP, so the BSTP final deadline of January 1, 2027 applies. The October 15 priority round has closed.
deadline.quote: The priority deadline is October 15th, and the final deadline is January 1st.

also.quote: The BSTP is the umbrella program through which students should apply for entry into the Neurosciences PhD Program.
The application for 2027 admission is open.

fee_waiver.value: Via BSTP: free application only for US citizens and permanent residents through October 15. International applicants get no waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fee waivers are not available to international students.

gre_subject.value: No neuroscience GRE rule is stated on the official pages.

supervisor.value: Students explore research areas before choosing a mentor, so admission does not depend on one.
supervisor.quote: Students can explore different areas of research before choosing a mentor.

funding.value: Via BSTP: students in laboratory-based biomedical PhD programmes receive financial support throughout their studies.
funding.quote: As a Case Western Reserve University biomedical PhD student in a laboratory-based program, you’ll receive financial support throughout your studies.

entry_route.value: The page does not state which degree is needed for entry.

notes: Two entry routes: BSTP (this record) and MSTP (MD/PhD, applied through AMCAS, not researched). Blocked: none.
